description: Captaciones por rangos is a dataset listed in Colombian national open data portal (datos.gov.co), an open data portal (Socrata), published or maintained by Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia - SUPERFINANCIERA, Bogotá D.C.. La información corresponde al saldo, número de cuentas y número de clientes de las principales captaciones por rangos de salarios mínimos mensuales legales vigentes y la fuente de la captación (red de oficinas y/o área de tesorería) de los establecimientos de crédito. Coverage: Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia - SUPERFINANCIERA, Bogotá D.C.. The portal files it under the publisher Superintendencia Financiera de Colombia - SUPERFINANCIERA, Bogotá D.C.. Its tags are cuentas corrientes, depósitos de ahorro, cdt. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal files it under the category Economía y Finanzas. The portal shows 2026-09-18 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datos-gov-co-portal.
